info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens Voice Channels API
List your voice channels for non-US zones

params.name: page
params.description: Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[size], page[number]

items.docs: Returns the non-US voice channels for your account. voice channels allow you to use Channel Billing for calls to your Telnyx phone numbers. Please check the Telnyx Support Articles section for full information and examples of how to utilize Channel Billing.

info.name: Update voice channels for non-US Zones

items.docs: Update the number of Voice Channels for the Non-US Zones. This allows your account to handle multiple simultaneous inbound calls to Non-US numbers. Use this endpoint to increase or decrease your capacity based on expected call volume.

info.name: List your voice channels for US Zone

items.docs: Returns the US Zone voice channels for your account. voice channels allows you to use Channel Billing for calls to your Telnyx phone numbers. Please check the Telnyx Support Articles section for full information and examples of how to utilize Channel Billing.

info.name: Update voice channels for US Zone

items.docs: Update the number of Voice Channels for the US Zone. This allows your account to handle multiple simultaneous inbound calls to US numbers. Use this endpoint to increase or decrease your capacity based on expected call volume.

info.name: List All Numbers using Channel Billing

items.docs: Retrieve a list of all phone numbers using Channel Billing, grouped by Zone.

info.name: List Numbers using Channel Billing for a specific Zone

items.docs: Retrieve a list of phone numbers using Channel Billing for a specific Zone.
